item.title: Kansas Jayhawks fight off BYU Cougars behind Tiller, Peterson
item.description: The top two prospects in the 2026 NBA Draft shared the court at Allen Fieldhouse in Lawrence, Kansas this afternoon, with Darryn Peterson's Kansas Jayhawks besting AJ Dybantsa's #13 BYU Cougars.

item.title: Kansas bookkeeper indicted in $1.5 million tax fraud
item.description: A Kansas bookkeeper is accused of failing to pay over $1.5 million in payroll taxes for clients.

item.title: Wichita businesses join 'National Shutdown' to protest ICE
item.description: WICHITA, Kan. (KSNW) — The shooting of Alex Pretti in Minneapolis has galvanized protests and demonstrations across the country. One protest took the form of a strike on Friday, with over a dozen businesses in Wichita closing up shop for the day, joining what organizers called a "National Shutdown." item.title: Boil Water Advisory issued for southeast Kansas town
item.description: A boil water advisory was issued for a town in Crawford County on Saturday.

item.title: Mystery of sticky substance in Kansas is solved — partially
item.description: Officials have identified the substance that spilled on the streets of a Kansas town, but who's responsible is still a mystery.

item.title: TSA rolls out ConfirmID option for travelers without REAL ID
item.description: TSA ConfirmID is a last-resort, fee-based option that allows TSA officers to attempt to verify a traveler's identity.

item.title: Sedgwick County Election Office corrects inaccurate voting information in Wichita Forward mailer
item.description: The Sedgwick County Election Office encourages voters to only rely on official election sources for accurate information.

item.title: Small plane overturns during takeoff attempt at Augusta airport
item.description: A small single-engine plane crashed while attempting its fourth takeoff Saturday morning at Augusta Municipal Airport.

item.title: Storm Track 3 Forecast: Few flakes tonight, warming trend to start the week
item.description: A few flakes will fly across central Kansas tonight. Meteorologist Lucy Doll tracks a much warmer trend for the start of the week.

item.title: KBI, McPherson County Sheriff investigate fatal shooting of teen
item.description: The Kansas Bureau of Investigation and the McPherson County Sheriff's Office are investigating a homicide that occurred early Saturday morning.
